title: Prune net phase domains and finish on the actual magnetization target
statement: Weighted geometric coverage and terminal-fibre rejection/mixing keep physical residence distinct from saddle hitting.

evidence.quote: ### Weighted pruning of principal phase domains
### Actual-target completion of the plus ocean

requires: Original periodic positive-field ferromagnetic Ising heat-bath model, one rate-one proposal clock PER SITE, theta=beta J fixed sufficiently large, phi=beta h=theta/R,R=J/h growing,n=L^2,CR<=L<=R^p. Source is allminus and actual target B={M>=0}; T_h=E_allminus tau_B. Retain acquired positive-field thermal core A=C_r,actual law pi_h(.|A),normalizer Z_A and source deficit D0 at their stated scope. Earlier core conditions theta>=4,1<=r<=R,r<L/4,contractible augmented plus components in r-by-r boxes and fixed zero-coupling contour diagonal are unchanged. Set w=exp(-beta H_h),physical conductance g(x,y)=w(x)c(x,y),C_kappa=kappa sum_A w(1-v),N_kappa=sum_(B^c)wv,Q_kappa=N_kappa/C_kappa;v is the decreasing probability that the core clock rings before B. New lobe/loop/open-graph constructions have their OWN additional geometric/temperature/field conditions, not an unrestricted theta4 closed-contour theorem.
Net plus phase domains exclude large minus holes from area and count their boundaries in perimeter; actual decreasing v and supplied/acquired plus-ocean thermal law/mixing at the source conditions.
provides: Frame comparison and ferromagnetic monotonicity give sum_{D occurs} wv<=exp[-2theta*P(D)+2phi*A(D)]*N_kappa. For fixedalpha in(1/2,1),principal domains withA(D)<=alpha*R*P(D) contribute at most an explicit small multiple of N_kappa as reported.
Every remaining principal plus domain has a quantitatively growable row or column. This is weighted COVERAGE, not completed physical transport of every retained domain.

The plus-ocean law has mu_plus(M>=0)>=1-2m_theta>1/2. Constant-acceptance rejection acquires its law conditioned on actualB. Reversing its physical mixing current gives a sink onM>=0 and polynomial residence bound. Do not assume every plus-ocean configuration is already absorbed.
assumptions: Full polynomial-time acquired confidence interval with endpoint ratio<=1+epsilon for the full physical mean remains UNACHIEVED. Missing is physical entropy-preserving transport through unrestricted principal contours and composition through growth, including multiple cut crossings,long irreducible junctions,remote contacts,and repeated principal-hole creation/removal. The new positive-field closed-loop law/normalizer is acquired only in a SPECIFIED regular eight-arc family; coverage of all significant critical current is unproved. Open corrected graph/SOS residence excludes fixed closure constraints and unrestricted overhangs. The source reports completed constructions; detailed in-chat document/PDF/code/audits remain unacquired, with some detailed family parameters/constants absent from this visible response. No new Capital/root science verification or audit overlay, external-review gate, physical interface, novelty or practical advantage is claimed. Earlier accepted core/open-arc scope and genuine failed routes remain intact. Every-increasing-path voltage bounds are an OPTIONAL sufficient route, not a necessary missing operation for the physical predictor.
costs: For the bounded-lobe family, source constructs divF=w1_E-q+rho with0<=q<=b_minus*w,|rho|<=xi*w and|F/g|<=Hcal, where Hcal may be exponential in perimeter cap P0=K0R. Actual ordered soft-current budget is k_star*C_kappa,k_star=ceil(n/2). Combined with an explicit capacity upper U_C and U_C<kappa, relative residence N_E/N_kappa<=b_minus+xi+Hcal*k_star*U_C/(1-U_C/kappa). Evaluate the analytic certificate in polynomial work as reported, rather than forming an exponential current table or simulating long repairs. Retained SHARPER join is Q_kappa<=T_h<=(1+kappa D0)Q_kappa+D0 for EVERYkappa>0; older fractional (Q+D0)/(1-kappa D0) requires kappa D0<1 and is not the current prerequisite. Capacity expression retains its actual(n+kappa) term and all entropy subtractions. Parameter conditioning gives|partial_theta logT|<=4n,|partial_phi logT|<=2n,so O(log(n/epsilon)) fractional bits suffice in dimensionless parameters in addition to representingR. Full unconditional predictor fallback still poly_theta(n,R,epsilon^-1,log(delta^-1))*exp(C_theta R); no polynomial full-mean algorithm is delivered.
